title: Separate Traits from Perception
description: When forming an impression: - Ask yourself: "Am I judging based on one good trait or the full picture?" - Challenge assumptions: Notice if a positive quality is influencing unrelated judgments. - Seek diverse feedback: Gather opinions from others to balance your perception. Example: A charismatic colleague may not always be the best leader—focus on skills, not charm.
